name: Matte Gouache Storybook
description: Opaque matte gouache storybook painting: chalky flat paint with dry-brush edges in dusty blues, sage greens and warm ochres, calm evening light, and simple rounded picture-book shapes.
style_bible: A picture-book painting in opaque gouache, where the paint is chalky and matte and never transparent. Medium and surface: gouache laid thickly enough to cover completely, so every shape is an opaque flat of colour with the gentle unevenness of hand-applied paint. There are no transparent washes, no colour bleeding beyond a shape's edge, no wet-in-wet blooms, no granulation and no visible pencil underdrawing. Brushwork: dry-brush strokes carry a visible tooth, and shape edges are soft and slightly ragged from the chalkiness of the medium — a hand-cut edge, never a hard vector line. Forms are built from a few broad simple strokes, with rounded, simplified shapes and only light hand-drawn detail inside them. Palette: gentle and muted — dusty blue, sage green, warm ochre and a soft warm off-white — held at low saturation with harmonious values so no single colour jumps forward. Lighting: soft, calm evening light, with gentle warm highlights and quiet shadows; contrast stays low and nothing is lit by a hard key. Composition: clear and simple picture-book staging with one readable focal point and calm space around it, built to be read at small size. A fine chalky paper tooth is visible in the dry passages. Content-independent: no fixed character, story, place or copied composition.
